description: This file defines the Response class used in JSON-RPC communication within the WebSockets namespace. The class provides methods to access response identifiers and to distinguish between result and error responses, encapsulating JSON-RPC response handling logic.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message with methods to access message details and validity checks.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response if available.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response if available.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the response message is valid.
